# Itqan Studio

> Itqan Studio is a Dubai-based design and AI agency. It is one partner for a founder's whole growth stack: brand identity and creative direction, websites that convert, content and social media marketing, SEO, AI visibility (generative engine optimization / GEO), web hosting and infrastructure, and agentic AI automation. Everything is designed, built and run by the same senior team. "Itqan" (إتقان) is Arabic for mastery/excellence.

Itqan Studio (legal name: Itqan Studio FZ LLC) operates from Dubai, United Arab Emirates, and serves clients across the UAE, the wider GCC, and globally. Most work is delivered remotely, so location is rarely a constraint. The studio works in English and Arabic. Its positioning: one senior team owns every piece that turns traffic into buyers, instead of splitting the work across disconnected agencies. Contact: info@itqanstudio.com.

## Team
- Ibrahim Shareef — CEO & Co-founder.
- Bisma Aslam — Head of Design & Co-founder.

## What Itqan Studio does (services)
- Brand Identity & Strategy: brand strategy, naming, positioning, creative direction, and full visual identity systems.
- Web Design & Development: fast, clear websites built to convert; design and full-stack engineering shipped as one system.
- Content & Social Media Marketing: a content engine that plans, produces and posts every week in the client's voice, across channels.
- SEO: the structure, content and technical signals that help the right buyers find a brand in search.
- AI Visibility (GEO): work to get a brand named when buyers ask ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini who to hire — built for and tracked, not guaranteed.
- Web Hosting & Infrastructure: hosting and running what the team builds, kept live, stable and maintained after launch.
- AI & Agentic Automation: agentic automation engines for lead capture, content, and reporting — run with a human in control.

Note on honesty: Itqan does not promise a specific search ranking or a guaranteed AI-engine citation. It builds for both and tracks results.

## Selected case studies
- [Millow](https://itqanstudio.com/work/millow): design partner for Sweden's fermented oat-protein platform (millow.co) — design system, motion language, Food Service rebuild, bilingual, 113 e2e tests green per release.
- [Mutqin](https://itqanstudio.com/work/mutqin): Itqan's own live AI startup companion — brand, character, and full-stack product (mutqin.xyz).
- [Nexilink](https://itqanstudio.com/work/nexilink): brand + investor-ready product UX delivered in 3 weeks; the client placed first at a 2024 investor competition.
- [Shareefico](https://itqanstudio.com/work/shareefico): personal brand + custom CMS + content-automation engine, shipped in under 30 days; two brands now publish 4+ pieces per week from one CMS (shareefi.co).
- [Project You](https://itqanstudio.com/work/project-you): a calm, faith-rooted life-OS SaaS with a verse-by-verse Qur'an companion (projectyou.app).
- [Oud Closet](https://itqanstudio.com/work/oud-closet): luxury modest-fashion brand identity + custom Shopify storefront, shipped in 2 weeks (oudcloset.se).
- [Medacs](https://itqanstudio.com/work/medacs): multi-stakeholder healthcare platform UX, validated and dev-ready in 2 weeks.
- [Itqan Studio CRM](https://itqanstudio.com/work/itqan-crm): the studio's own operations platform, built in 6 weeks; replaced 5 tools and cut Friday P&L reconciliation from 8 hours to 15 minutes, with UAE-compliant e-invoicing.
